extension.description: A live "OSS ticker": a scrolling row of open-source ecosystem indicators (GitHub stars/tags, npm downloads, HuggingFace, CVEs, Mastodon…), fetched client-side and cached in the browser. Fully configurable.

field.name: title
field.label: Ticker title
field.description: Small heading shown above the ticker.

field.name: loading_text
field.label: Loading text
field.description: Shown while the first data loads.

field.name: nodata_text
field.label: No-data text
field.description: Shown if no indicator could be fetched.

field.name: tooltip_title
field.label: Tooltip heading
field.description: Bold heading inside each hover tooltip.

field.name: scroll_seconds
field.label: Scroll duration (s)
field.description: Seconds for one full scroll cycle (higher = slower).

field.name: fetch_count
field.label: Indicators fetched
field.description: How many random indicators to fetch per refresh.

field.name: show_count
field.label: Indicators shown
field.description: How many to display in the scrolling row.

field.name: cache_hours
field.label: Cache (hours)
field.description: How long the browser caches fetched data before refetching.

field.name: color_bg
field.label: Background
field.description: Overrides --ticker-bg (leave empty for the built-in dark/light theme).

field.name: indicators
field.label: Indicators (JSON)
field.description: Leave EMPTY to use the built-in 49 indicators. Otherwise paste a JSON array. Each item: {label, icon, relevance, type, arg, value, change, tone, url}. Supported type: gh_stars, gh_tag, npm_week, gh_search, gh_advisory, hf_top, mastodon, static.
